ItemID: NA; Title: Guardians of the Galaxy; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soundtrack's older pop and rock appeal to me, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Be My Baby / Various; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This looks promising for my interest in older pop compilations, but I would check the track list before choosing it.

ItemID: NA; Title: Big Hits of the 80's; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in Christmas music and earlier classic hits right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pure 80's Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I sometimes enjoy this era, but another broad '80s collection is not what I want today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hipsters' Holiday: Vocal Jazz and R&B Classics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this because it connects my current holiday interest with the vocal jazz appeal of Cheek to Cheek.
